Select the option that tells you about Jack being a great storyteller. 
1. Jack knew the right way to the wizard’s house as if he had been there. 
2. Jack was commendable at giving his story realistic details. 
3. Jack’s delivery of speech with sound effects was remarkable. 
4. Jack looked like a really old man as if he was the wizard.

She held on to the covers tightly and compressed her lips.
She relaxed, knowing that her father was around to protect her.
She instantly responded in the voice of another character.

Jo thought of the skunk’s mother as a villain for not letting him make 
friends.

Jo was interrupting her father’s narrative just to annoy him and have 
fun.

Jo liked the wizard more and so she took pity on him for getting 
beaten.

Statement 1: Jo was adding bits to the story created by her own imagination. 
Statement 2: Jack was tired and felt relaxed since he didn’t have to complete 
the whole story.
options:
Statement 1 can be inferred from the extract but Statement 2 cannot 
be.

Statement 1 is cannot be inferred from the extract but Statement 2 can 
be.

questions.question:
“Ah, but do you care if you never kiss them. ” What does Mr. Lamb aim to do 
with such a statement?
questions.explanation: CBSE Official Question Bank Stand-Alone Answer Key: Option (A).

questions.question: Choose the option that best constitutes a message from the play:
options: People’s attitude should not stop one from experiencing life.
What people say has no bearing upon how one feels about things.
People cannot be changed. One can and should only change oneself.
One’s opinions cannot be based on what people say behind one’s back.
questions.explanation: CBSE Official Question Bank Stand-Alone Answer Key: Option (A).
